messages:
nora (docs): Quick question on PR #7012: I replaced 'quota' header samples with the new 'plan' header in SDK examples, but a reviewer asked we keep a short compatibility note. Proposing: 'Note: legacy header x-rw-quota is supported and maps to x-rw-usage-plan.' Thoughts?
sam (eng): That mapping text is fine. Also can you update the cURL to show a streaming response example? People ask about partial counts.
paul (product): Agree on compatibility note. UX prefers phrase 'grace credits' not 'burst'. Please use that in the examples and the callout.
nora (docs): Got it. I'll change 'burst' -> 'grace credits' and add the one-line migration note. Draft cURL and short JS snippet below:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\
  -H "x-rw-usage-plan: team" \\
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage?stream=true
```
```js
fetch('/v1/usage', {headers: {'x-rw-usage-plan': 'team'}})
  .then(r => r.text()).then(console.log)
```
ci-bot: docs-ci: lint started for PR #7012
sam (eng): tiny nit: in the docs text, mention that grace credits are consumed before plan quota and do not auto-refill mid-cycle. Otherwise +1.
ci-bot: docs-ci: lint passed ✅
nora (docs): Thanks, merging after I push the tiny edits. Will add redirect for old header doc anchor. Closing thread.
